reading_scope.libbrecht2015_reanalysis: All six pages read, including equations 2-13, sample-area humidity depletion, unit near-step attachment assumption and factor-three migration-length uncertainty. This is a reanalysis of basal data, not an accepted correction to later prism measurements.
reading_scope.shi2025_molecular: Introduction, methodology II A-B, selected III growth-rate discussion, conclusion IV and data availability read. Qualitative temperature/habit correspondence is distinguished from a measured vapour-growth law; supplementary data not downloaded.

source_claims.humidity_depletion: Libbrecht 2015 arXiv:1509.06609 argues that chamber-wide depletion and near-step attachment assumptions explain a much smaller migration length than the original basal analysis. Its chamber approximation and inferred length retain substantial uncertainty.
source_claims.prism_humidity_assumption: Miyamoto 2022 equations 1 and 5 determine beta from the low-nominal-supersaturation slope assuming local and reservoir humidity coincide, then infer local humidity from measured step speed. The same beta enters the spiral-spacing inversion.
source_claims.molecular_alternative: Shi et al. 2025, doi:10.1063/5.0240795, uses LAMMPS with TIP4P/Ice and mW to recrystallize an artificially enlarged quasi-liquid surface layer in vacuum. It supplies molecular mechanism comparisons, not a humidity-resolved atmospheric crystal or lunar column solver. Data are advertised at doi:10.18742/27080410; the dataset was not downloaded.

limits: No fitted humidity correction or new equilibrium parameter is adopted.
Source files are stored in ignored caches; only identities and scoped interpretation are redistributed.
The moving-interface code remains an independent axisymmetric event/FV prototype, without three-dimensional branching, a reversible surface field, or resolved gas flow.
